expansions.expansionJustification: 本次新增的云测试、记忆、模型路由与 RAG 漏斗叶子用例均仅有规格、计划或局部合同，尚无 traceability manifest 的 primary binding；显式登记为 planned/unmapped，不计入 required 分母、passed 或 release evidence。
Worker 事件唤醒的七类叶子已具规格和局部运行时合同，但真实 PostgreSQL 事务、trigger、RLS、多副本和恢复验证因本机隔离数据库无法启动而未完成；在 primary binding 和正确数据面证据前显式登记为 planned/unmapped，不计入 required 分母、passed 或 release evidence。
长时专家面试运行时的叶子用例仅为审计后冻结的计划与门禁；INT-TRANSCRIPT-00 的删除授权和逐 sink receipt 及 INT-TRANSCRIPT-01 同迁移删后读零尚未实现。显式登记为 planned/unmapped，不计入 required 分母、passed 或 release evidence。
公开预览目录和公开只读 ingress 的七类用例已冻结为 planned/unmapped。它们不进入 required 绑定、passed 分母或 release evidence；ECS 主应用仍被发布清单、健康与网络边界阻断。

The ECS full-stack preview, public-preview web ingress and preview synthetic-data factory seven-case matrices are explicitly planned/unmapped. They add no required binding, passed denominator or release evidence; the public runtime remains blocked pending a verified release manifest binding HTTPS, listener mode, image digest and health evidence.
